values.amputationBasis: single projectile event in one target and canonical limb, summed across its disjoint channels; never across events
values.comminutionBasis: same event target part bone-energy prefix; current original positive bone intersection required; first crossing only

debugUIDOM.scope: DOM-only; actual TrainingInput and DebugAmmoUI, no renderer or model
debugUIDOM.evidenceScope: unchanged UI source reference; final gameplay independently verified

gelatin.method: Literal deep equality of all gelatinProfile fields and every 5 mm sample against v39. Original resolveBodyPath is then applied to a 2 m homogeneous occupied block at the same source mass/speed, using three unchanged original body resistance classes. Legacy has no gelatin material: these are explicitly body-class analogues, not fabricated gelatin constants.

singleHitEnergy.method: 114 registered cartridges at registry muzzle velocity, one projectile per trace, no manual velocity override. Three actual standing limb fixture paths each at 1 m. Reported maximum means maximum among these three sampled paths, not exhaustive geometry. Amputation uses same-shot/actor/limb delivered energy summed across disjoint channels, never accumulated multi-shot energy. Both individual channel maxima and whole-limb sums are reported.

ordinaryGlobalBound.assumptions: All valid production flight samples are limited to t_max; drag and existing walls/armor only remove energy. The triangle inequality includes possible gravitational acceleration. This bound is conservative, not a predicted impact energy. Applies to registry speeds without manual debug overrides. A manually increased debug speed can exceed 8000 J even for an ordinary cartridge, intentionally unrealistic.

postBody.method: Actual standing soldier geometry → production traceShot → actual newly registered rear wall collider or independent second soldier → existing medical record. Same fixed target/direction and shot RNG on v39/S2. New walls use existing 25 mm drywall and 18 mm wood materials and unchanged wall equations. No synthetic damage or body velocity override.
postBody.secondaryCloudPolicy: S2 cloud energy can continue between parts/paths of the same actor. At a wall/armor/new actor/end it is reported as untracedFragmentEnergyJ and never added to primary velocity or new target fragment energy.

debugWeaponGameplay.method: Actual game runtime rebundled only with existing external __CQBTest observations; embedded release assets; offline; RAF held for deterministic production tick/fire. Native keyboard/CDP touch and DebugAmmoUI controls. No replaced trace, anatomy, wound or medical result.
debugWeaponGameplay.fixture: H01 original armored rest target; player relocated 5 m in front; breath/walk sway disabled for repeatable aim; recoil and all real ballistic/medical calculations retained. No revival or medical reset during firing.

s0Matrix240.note: PASS applies only to a declared per-case clinical expectation; RECORDED is not an acceptance claim. New body exits and stopping intentionally differ.

qSixInvariants.method: Actual S2 shot replay. Same six Q invariants as S0 checked every1/60s clinical tick; includes301s brainstem and900s major artery cases. No medical values are injected.

structuralHP0.method: Repeated identical actual7N6 rays with no elapsed time between shots untilpartHP0; noHP/stateinjection. Explicitstructuralfixture,notrealfirecadenceorsurvivalcount. Thenoneproductioncombattick; torsodeathtransition usesmedical.tick onlyafterphysicalposefreeze.

cavityDebug.evidenceScope: final frozen fefede27 capture; existing checkbox, actual trace/medical

reportViewer.evidenceScope: final data report rendered and reviewed; not game performance

performance.method: 600 fixed 1/60-second ticks; 10 logical 1200 RPM emitters, independent phase/shot IDs, 200 shots each. Actual traceShot, posed original anatomical geometry, actual medical record/tick. Dead actor geometry stays posed, but clinical postmortem skipping is retained. Two order-balanced serial repetitions.
performance.differential: S2 versus the complete immutable v39 runtime. The reference retains old body resistance plus S1 shadow medical channels; S2 has authoritative channels and S2 HP semantics. This is a physical/clinical model comparison, not a pure overhead off-switch. No null computeWoundChannel, fake substitute physics or product toggle is used. The archived warm argument pool is released before stress; original pre-optimization measurements are retained separately.

criteria.note: Micro samples are per occupied part; the actual per-shot channel-sum distribution additionally captures every part traversed by a hit. Event/quiet is a medical-only comparator, not a rendered gameplay frame. The 0.1 ms requirement applies to the sum of every occupied-part channel call made by one actual hit, not only the individual-part micro p95.

performanceTargets.note: passed means measurement/provenance assertions completed. It does not claim every performance target passes or 60 Hz gameplay.

directVsEquivalentDepth.note: Identical captured arguments including tissue cache and stateIn; direct cell arithmetic versus eager equivalent-depth LUT. Differences are reported, not hidden.

performance.interpretation: Both whole-hit p95 runs miss0.1ms despite per-part micro passes. All4arms2000/2000 bodyentries and600ticks. CPUframes exclude renderer/AI/ragdoll/audio; no60Hz or full-game frame-budget claim. Clinical alive/postmortem states differ, so ratios are not pure overhead comparisons.

limitations: Final whole-hit p95 A0.141673ms/B0.141573ms misses0.1ms although individual-part micro p95 passes. No60Hz gameplay claim.
